verdict.rationale: The evidence for AvaTax covers tax calculation, transactions, nexus and MCP access, with no filing calendar, per-filing status, remitted amounts or downloadable confirmations. The only filing-related item describes a separate product (the Managed Returns API) that embeds return preparation and filing, and it says nothing about filing visibility or confirmations. The community item also notes that AvaTax-style tools still require handling filing separately.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted
